scope: Same-author controls; pass counts are not empirical or external scientific validation.

Zero-potential partial waves return the identity scattering matrix

All new collapse runs conserve charge plus their numerical receiver
All 18 raw traces reconstruct their recorded lossless hashes and final times
Finite-time prototype charge agrees within one percent across fine grids and boundary controls
All three fine nodal grids resolve the core radius with at least ten points
Every masked exterior projection preserves its measured canonical charge
